description: This file defines REST storage providers and bootstrap configuration management for Kubernetes flow control API, including setting up storage for flow schemas and priority level configurations, and ensuring bootstrap configurations are applied and maintained.

classes.name: RESTStorageProvider
classes.description: Provides REST storage for flow control API resources and manages bootstrap configuration post-start hook.

classes.name: bootstrapConfigurationEnsurer
classes.description: Handles ensuring and reconciling bootstrap flow control configurations.

methods.name: NewRESTStorage
methods.description: Creates new REST storage for flow control API resources.

methods.name: storage
methods.description: Sets up storage mappings for flow schemas and priority level configurations.

methods.name: GroupName
methods.description: Returns the API group name for flow control.

methods.name: PostStartHook
methods.description: Returns the post-start hook for bootstrap configuration.

methods.name: ensureAPFBootstrapConfiguration
methods.description: Ensures bootstrap flow control configuration is applied and periodically reconciled.
